_WARNING: SHADOW-ONLY LIMITS. NOT PRODUCTION VALUES. NOT A RECOMMENDATION.
_purpose: Lets SHADOW replays run and produce evidence before any human has chosen real numbers. Every value below is a conservative placeholder derived from the account's own history, not from any view about what risk is appropriate. Production values are open decision D-1 and remain the account owner's to make.

_derivation.max_account_risk_fraction: 0.005 = 0.5% of allocated equity. On $6,474 that is ~$32/trade, so 20 consecutive losses cost ~10% of the account.
_derivation.max_daily_loss_fraction: 0.02 = 4 max-risk trades. Deliberately tight: the recorded history has an average loss of $433, which is 6.7% of the current account.
_derivation.max_drawdown_fraction: 0.15 = halt well before the recorded history's realized drawdown.
_derivation.max_consecutive_losses: 6 — a 1.5:1 system at a 40% win rate hits 6 straight losses often enough to be normal, but 6 is where a human should look.
_derivation.max_open_positions: 1 — one position at a time until there is any evidence at all.

name: shadow_limits
